b2b14a3b61e080573afa.title: Show HN: I built a free collection of browser-based 3D tools
b2b14a3b61e080573afa.snippet: I built 3DValley, a collection of free tools for generating and editing 3D models. You can turn images into 3D models using AI, retexture existing models, remesh geometry, and use other 3D utilities. Some tools run entirely in your browser, while the more computationally expensive AI models run on shared GPUs with free daily credits.
